preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 100000 for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string 'a' has a length between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ANTO' for c in a) for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string 'a' is one of 'A', 'N', 'O', or 'T'.
The total length of all strings 'a' across all test cases does not exceed 100000.

postconditions.description: The number of output strings matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == len(a) for a, b in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each output string 'b' has the same length as the corresponding input string 'a'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ANTO' for c in b) for b in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string 'b' is one of 'A', 'N', 'O', or 'T'.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(b) == sorted(a) for a, b in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each output string 'b' is a permutation of the corresponding input string 'a'.

postconditions.expression: all(max_inversions(b) == max_inversions(a) for a, b in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: The maximum number of inversions in the output string 'b' is equal to the maximum number of inversions in the corresponding input string 'a'.
